decks.notes: This deck aims to quickly ramp up mana through the use of Amulet of Vigor and bounce lands to play Primeval Titan as early as possible. The deck utilizes the Titan's ability to search for specific lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Vesuva to deal large amounts of damage quickly. The combination of Amulet of Vigor and bounce lands allows for explosive turns where multiple lands can be played in a single turn. The inclusion of cards like Arboreal Grazer and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove help to accelerate mana production even further.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo of Colossus Hammer and Puresteel Paladin to equip a creature with a massive amount of power and evasion. The deck also includes cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Steelshaper's Gift to search for key pieces, as well as support cards like Sigarda's Aid and Urza's Saga to enable the combo. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a large, flying, and potentially indestructible threat early in the game.

This deck focuses on utilizing powerful, aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent along with efficient removal spells such as Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to put pressure on the opponent quickly. It also includes disruptive spells like Spell Snare, Spell Pierce, and Counterspell to control the game and protect its threats. The deck aims to win the game as quickly as possible while disrupting the opponent's game plan, making it difficult for them to stabilize and respond effectively.

The key strategy of this deck is to quickly assemble the combination of Stoneforge Mystic, Puresteel Paladin, and Colossus Hammer to create a powerful attacking creature. With the aid of Sigarda's Aid and Urza's Saga, the deck can equip Colossus Hammer onto a creature for a massive damage output. This deck also utilizes cards like Esper Sentinel and Shadowspear for control and protection, making it a versatile and aggressive combo deck that can quickly overwhelm opponents.

This deck focuses on utilizing the combo potential of Indomitable Creativity paired with cards like Archon of Cruelty and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to cheat powerful creatures onto the battlefield quickly. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Inquisition of Kozilek and Lightning Bolt to control the opponent's strategy. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to create unexpected and explosive plays by combining creativity with a variety of powerful creatures and disruptive spells.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear, Soul-Scar Mage, Sprite Dragon, and Dragon's Rage Channeler, along with burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart, to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The deck also includes spells like Expressive Iteration and Underworld Breach to maximize card advantage and maintain pressure on the opponent. Jegantha, the Wellspring is included as a companion to provide additional mana flexibility. Overall, the deck aims to win the game quickly through a combination of creature damage and burn spells.

The deck revolves around cycling creatures and manipulating the graveyard to quickly fill it with creatures before casting Living End, a powerful combo spell that allows you to return all creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield. By cycling through your deck, you can set up the perfect Living End turn, overwhelming your opponent with a sudden swarm of creatures. With counter spells and disruptive creatures, you can control the game until you assemble your combo and win in a explosive turn.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage and value through cards like Teferi, Time Raveler, Wrenn and Six, and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. The deck also has a strong mana base with a mix of fetch lands and multicolor lands to ensure consistent mana fixing. Additionally, it includes powerful finishers like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines to close out the game once control has been established.

This deck focuses on utilizing cards like Indomitable Creativity and Transmogrify to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty early in the game. The combination of cards like Wrenn and Six and Dwarven Mine helps generate mana and tokens to fuel the combo, while cards like Teferi, Time Raveler disrupt opponents' interaction. The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo pieces, using a mix of removal and counter spells to protect the payoff creatures once they hit the battlefield. The deck's strategy revolves around creative ways to cheat out game-ending threats and overpower the opponent.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays combined with powerful removal spells to control the game. The deck utilizes cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer to apply pressure early on, while also running cards like Lightning Bolt and Prismatic Ending to efficiently deal with threats. The addition of Blood Moon disrupts opponent's mana base, while the inclusion of companions like Obosh, the Preypiercer provides additional synergy with the deck's odd converted mana cost creatures. With a mix of efficient creatures and removal, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing cards that disrupt the opponent's strategy and resources. Utilizing cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to deal with threats, while also ramping up with Cabal Coffers and Karn, the Great Creator. The deck also includes cards like Night's Whisper and Relic of Progenitus for card advantage and graveyard hate. Overall, this mono black control deck aims to outvalue the opponent and control the game until it can win through attrition or with powerful finishers like Damnation and Sheoldred's Edict.

The deck focuses on using creatures to assemble powerful combos and generate value, while also toolboxing for specific creature cards with Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution. It utilizes Golgari lands and mana dorks to accelerate its game plan, with cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide acting as key combo pieces. The deck also includes disruption with Endurance and Hapatra, Vizier of Poisons, along with additional value engines like Blood Artist and Prosperous Innkeeper. It aims to overwhelm opponents with a versatile and resilient creature-based strategy.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining control of the board. With a mix of spells like Counterspell, Archmage's Charm, and Unholy Heat, along with versatile creatures like Snapcaster Mage and Teferi, Temporal Pilgrim, the deck can adapt to various situations and outmaneuver the opponent. The mana base includes various fetch lands and shock lands to ensure consistency and flexibility in casting spells. Overall, it's a versatile and adaptable control deck designed to outsmart and outlast the opponent.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize a combination of cards to quickly and efficiently assemble a win condition without relying on traditional lands. By using cards like Balustrade Spy and Undercity Informer to mill the deck and put Vengevine and other key creatures into the graveyard, the deck can quickly overwhelm opponents with a combination of creatures and spells. The deck also includes alternate win conditions such as Thassa's Oracle and Goblin Charbelcher to ensure multiple paths to victory. Overall, the deck focuses on fast, explosive plays to outpace opponents and secure a quick win.

Utilizing Indomitable Creativity to quickly bring out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Leyline Binding while controlling the game with spells like Lightning Bolt and Spell Pierce. The deck also includes Teferi, Time Raveler for additional control and card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to create a powerful board state and overwhelm the opponent with a quick and efficient combo.

The main idea of this deck is to use creatures with built-in resilience and enter-the-battlefield abilities to create a toolbox of options for different situations. By using cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution, the deck can tutor for specific creatures to respond to threats or advance its game plan. Additionally, the inclusion of Yawgmoth, Thran Physician allows for additional value by sacrificing creatures and drawing cards. The deck also includes cards like Essence Warden and Blood Artist to gain life and drain the opponent, respectively.
